rules.hold: Qt 6.6 is the validated iOS toolchain and KDE ABI cohort; upgrade it as one lane.
KDE release-service applications must move together with the Qt/KF6 cohort.
SpiderMonkey 115 is the GNOME 46 ESR/toolchain cohort.
2.46 and newer require C++23 features unsupported by the current iOS Clang 14 lane.
Xwayland is coupled to the existing Xserver patch and Procursus ABI lane.
FFmpeg is an ABI-sensitive shared dependency; upgrade its consumers as a cohort.

rules.ignore: Krita is an intentional date-stamped upstream development snapshot.
LuaJIT is commit-pinned; update only with its patch/build lane.
Xios-owned package version, not an upstream dependency.

linux-build/recipes/qt6-common.mk:QT6_VE.hold: Qt 6.6 is the validated iOS toolchain and KDE ABI cohort; upgrade it as one lane.

linux-build/recipes/kf6-common.mk:KF6_VE.hold: KF6 6.3 is the validated Plasma 6.1 and Qt 6.6 cohort.

linux-build/recipes/kf6-common.mk:PLASMA.hold: Plasma 6.1 is the validated KF6 6.3 and Qt 6.6 cohort.

linux-build/recipes/kf6-common.mk:PWP_VE.hold: Plasma Wayland protocols are part of the validated Plasma 6.1 build cohort.
